task: Deploy the updated config for the notification service that was modified 20 minutes ago.

candidate_memories.content: Config changes to notification-svc must be validated with make validate-config COMPONENT=notification-svc before deployment; invalid config causes silent message drops.
Config updated 20 min ago by on-call engineer to increase SMTP connection pool from 10 to 50; change not yet validated or deployed.
Validated config is deployed via kubectl apply -f config/notification-svc/production.yaml; rolling restart happens automatically.
Config changes to notification-svc have historically caused silent failures when pool sizes exceed SMTP server limits; verify SMTP server max connections before increasing pool.
